entries.notes: Role-home launcher reconciled to Lantern (Fraunces headline, No-Line tiles on warm paper). Role-curated dashboard widgets (My Patients, AR snapshot, cosign queue) await their modules.

Rebuilt to the frame's MAR Grid: Patient Workspace (banner + module rail) | the Medication Administration Record grid (rows = medication orders, columns = dose times, cells = the dose's §2.2 status, selectable) + a recent-administrations strip | a right 'Administer' rail (five-rights scaffold). REAL: scheduled-dose grid + administration history + late-entry/controlled/RN-review pills. Honest gaps: dose rows carry the medication ORDER id, not the drug/dose text the frame shows (no fabricated drug name); the administration WRITE paths (single-dose/PRN/witness) aren't built, so Record administration is an inert scaffold naming the write path.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner + module rail | orders table (kind · priority · status · live 48h verbal countdown, row-select) | right rail with the selected order's detail + Open order. All real (M11 order lifecycle data + CountdownChip on the real verbal deadline). Honest gap: the list carries the order KIND, not the clinical order text (drug/dose) the frame shows — that lives on /orders/:id — so rows label by kind, never a fabricated drug name.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner | visit-note document (note title + status, a vitals strip, a SUBJECTIVE/OBJECTIVE/ASSESSMENT/PLAN scaffold) | right rail (Sign-off + EVV/visit), over a sticky footer (cosign guard + actions). REAL: header (type/discipline/date/status/late-entry/version), cosignature state, signed/cosigned timestamps, patient banner. Honest placeholders — the encounter read DTO exposes NO note body or vitals, so those cells/sections render '—' (never a fabricated note); EVV/visit join (M17/M18) isn't on the DTO; footer uses real nav, not the unbuilt Save-draft / Sign-note write paths.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: banner | scale list | selected scale's score + capture history | a right-rail score trend. REAL throughout (scales, per-capture total scores + interpretation, captured-at/by, cosign-needed, SUD/redacted, the trend bars computed from the real score series). Honest substitution — the timeline exposes each capture's TOTAL score, not the per-item breakdown the frame's symptom bars show, so the center shows the score + history rather than fabricating per-symptom values.

Rebuilt to the frame's Patient Workspace: patient banner + module nav rail | a document-style 'Interdisciplinary care plan' card (every problem with its goals + interventions inline) | a right rail (IDG review + AI suggestion), over a sticky footer (IDG-quorum guard + actions). REAL: problems/goals/interventions, version+signers, patient banner. Honest substitutions — AI suggestion is a placeholder (M29 Clinical Copilot not built, no fabricated suggestion); no next-review date in the API (CoP note + signers shown instead); footer uses the real nav actions (Version history / summary / open draft) rather than the frame's unbuilt Save-draft / Submit-for-IDG write paths.

Banner (avatar + Fraunces name + DOB·age meta + MRN/status chips + Message action), icon nav rail, and Summary card composition + right Alerts/Tasks rail all match the frame. Problems / benefit-period / alerts / tasks cards are honest placeholders (Care Plan, Admission, Tasks modules).

Rebuilt to the frame's 'Card Sign in': gold hearth mark + Fraunces 'WardenX' lockup, Sign in title + subtitle, filled fields, full-width pill button, and a 'Forgot password? · Use a passkey' links row. Fully real — email/password + passkey both go through Better Auth; no placeholders.

Rebuilt to the frame's 'Card Two-factor verification' (same a1dbhD frame as Sign in): branded card, Fraunces title + subtitle, a segmented 6-digit mono OTP input (auto-advance + paste), full-width pill Verify. Fully real (TOTP + backup code via Better Auth). The frame's 'Resend code' link — which implies SMS/email OTP — is replaced by the functional backup-code toggle (our 2FA is authenticator/TOTP, which has no resend).

Rebuilt to the frame: Fraunces title, Notifications/Tasks/Mentions pill tabs + an inline stats strip, and a §6.2 No-Line card of rows (severity glyph + summary + source chip + status pill + relative time). The Notifications tab is the REAL alert inbox (GET /api/v1/alerts/inbox) with live Unread/Urgent/Failed stats; Tasks & Mentions are honest placeholders (Tasks/worklist module).

Rebuilt to the frame's Conversation View: a 'Messages' list (avatar + title + scope + unread dot, active row indigo-tinted) | a thread of chat bubbles (mine right/indigo via the real session user id, others left/paper) under a patient-scoped chip header, over a rounded composer. All real M36 data; the list's last-message preview/time isn't exposed by the channels read yet, so the secondary line shows the channel's real scope instead.

All 7 chromeless states (404/403/500/offline/maintenance/session-expired/suspended) render the System Page pattern matched to the frame: a circular tonal icon badge holding a Lantern inline-SVG Glyph (replacing the old emoji — §10.10), Fraunces headline, muted explanation, forward action, mono correlation id. CenteredStatusLayout enhanced to draw the badge.

Rebuilt to the frame's centered results column: per-scope No-Line cards with avatar + name + meta + status + chevron rows that navigate to the record. Patient + staff scopes are REAL (RLS/caseload + member.manage scoped); documents/orders/visits/commands are honest 'available when <module> ships' rows.

Header (title + Admit action), KPI strip, work table, and right detail panel match the frame. Census KPI is the REAL active count (GET /patients/census-metrics); Admissions/Discharges/GIP/Recerts KPIs are honest '—' placeholders noting their owning module (M6 / billing).
